questions.question_english: 45. In the context of Centre-State relations and fiscal federalism, how do recent Finance Commission guidelines and central transfers compare regarding tax devolution?
options_english: Compulsory legal surrender of all local municipal and state-level tax collection powers directly to the Central Board of Direct Taxes.
Discretionary financial transfers granted exclusively to state administrations featuring political alignment with single-party systems.
Shareable central tax proceeds are devolved based on formula criteria incorporating population, income distance, and forest cover.
Retaining 100% of all central tax revenue collections within the Union government while maintaining zero financial devolution to states.
questions.explanation_english: Fiscal federalism principles in India govern central tax devolution to states based on recommendations by the Finance Commission. This mechanism balances vertical fiscal imbalances between Centre and states while addressing horizontal equity among states possessing unequal fiscal capacities.
